name: Transit Map
summary: A printed octilinear metro schematic lying on a dark table: lines drawn by glowing pen tips, white stops and interchange capsules, every label printed on the sheet, a cream-drum counter on an enamel plate, and a real perspective camera that rides, tilts and pulls back with shallow focus.
suits: growth of a network over time
routes, roadmaps and careers drawn as lines
two rivals on one time axis
a topic drawn as a network (labelled as a metaphor)

palette.use: the near-black warm table under the sheet
ink: labels, interchange outlines, casings, the cartouche bar
warm grey: second lines and notes
the first section, the you-are-here dot, the verdict; also the 700 nm line
the darker edge of water (0.025 G)
water names set along the band
the plate's rim and drum wells
line 580 (yellow; light: ink inside its bullet) (proposed)

type.units: sizes in grid units G (1 G = 120 px at the standard zoom)
type.case: sentence case names; capitals for hubs
type.emphasis: the red accent and stamped verdicts; hub labels grow on pull-back

banned: segments off 0°, 45° or 90°; wiggling lines; capsules turned to 45°
transport mode shown by colour (no "ferry blue"); dark overlays (fade with a paper veil)
floating title cards or captions over the picture; time-flashed labels; labels placed against a partly drawn network
counters that interpolate or show unsourced figures; unchecked facts; an invented network not labelled as such
operator logos or branded bullets; copying Beck or Vignelli layouts, faces, icons or bullets, or naming them
a top view for the whole film; a camera lower than about 25° above the paper; fades to black mid-film
white-on-blue blueprint linework, isometric diagrams, 3D city maps, keynote slides
